units.source_text: 大公主身边的侍女，见了匂皇子怕难为情，都在一旁躲避着。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting around the First Princess felt shy when they saw Prince Niou, so they all kept aside and hid themselves.

units.source_text: 大公主想道：“别的诗都咏得，何必说这种古怪的话呢！”

en.t: The First Princess thought, "He could have composed any other poem, so why say such strange things?"
For that reason, she left it unanswered.

units.source_text: 匂皇子情知姐姐这态度是有理的。

en.t: Prince Niou fully understood that his elder sister's attitude was reasonable.

units.source_text: 可知在五中将的那个咏“何须顾虑多”的妹妹过于轻狂，实甚可憎。

en.t: This showed that the younger sister of the Fifth Captain, who had composed the line "Why worry so much," was far too frivolous and truly objectionable.

units.source_text: 这大公主和匂皇子两人，是紫夫人特别疼爱而亲手抚育长成的。

en.t: The First Princess and Prince Niou had both been especially beloved by Lady Murasaki and raised by her own hands.

units.source_text: 在许多皇子皇女中，这两人互相也特别亲近。

en.t: Among the many princes and princesses, these two were also especially close to each other.

units.source_text: 明石皇后对大公主的关怀无微不至，侍女中略有缺陷的人，概不使用。

en.t: Empress Akashi cared for the First Princess in every detail and would not employ any lady-in-waiting who had even the slightest flaw.

units.source_text: 故大公主身边的侍女中，有许多身份高贵的女子。

en.t: Therefore, among the ladies-in-waiting around the First Princess, there were many women of noble rank.

units.source_text: 匂皇子是个容易移情的人，看见姿色殊胜的侍女，就和她调笑。

en.t: Prince Niou was a man whose affections shifted easily, and whenever he saw an especially beautiful lady-in-waiting, he would jest and flirt with her.

units.source_text: 但他无时或忘宇治的二女公子，音信不通已多日了。

en.t: Yet he never for a moment forgot the two young ladies of Uji, though many days had already passed with no word from them.
